title: World Bloom — Ordinary, Yet Special Us — Episode10 Forever Stargazers

meta.Event Outline: Things have been going well for Leo/need since their professional debut. One day, a change in the tree in their SEKAI brings them to a dream world—one where they never became estranged.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Now that I know I'm writing a song to show them all my support, it's become so much easier to come up with the melody and lyrics for it.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I also know which feelings to channel into it.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Huh? Aren't you gonna go buy lunch, Hoshino...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I have to take care of something else first.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
This part feels a little sad and lonely.
I'm trying to show support, so it needs to feel more optimistic.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Seeing them all work hard has allowed me to finally take a big step forward. That's why I want to help them do the same...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The more they pursue their own goals, the less we'll get to see each other.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “As long as our hearts are one”...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, just “our hearts are one”...
That should also make Miku smile when she sings it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I know.
I should try having Miku sing it now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...!
This is much closer to what I've been envisioning!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I like this melody, so I could try throwing in a few extra sounds to give it more volume.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want this song to guide them.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (So they can reach the places they want to go without ever getting lost.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (No matter how far apart we are, we'll always be together.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And Miku's going to deliver that message.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I did it! My song for Saki and the others is done...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm a little sleep-deprived, but I managed to finish it in time for the meteor shower...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What time is it...?
Okay, good. It started raining when it got dark, but how's the weather now?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's still cloudy. I can't see anything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I was hoping to have them listen to it while watching the meteor shower since we can't do that together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I finished writing my song, so I should send it to them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Thank you for bearing with me all this time. I wouldn't have been able to complete this song without you.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Please take my feelings, and deliver them to Saki and the others through the song we made together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm starting to feel really nervous for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I'll go take a quick walk.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You guys also did awesome!
Get home safe, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(That trip we took today was so much fun.
Not only did I learn a lot, I even got to become friends with the girls over there.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I hope we get to go back...
*Yawn*
So sleepy. Even though I slept a ton on the bus ride back...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(It's already past seven...
I know it's a little early, but I might take a bath and go straight to bed when I get home.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, wait, the meteor shower...!
Isn't right now the best time to watch?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's too cloudy! I can't see anything...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I wonder if Ichi and the others are trying to watch it right now too.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I really enjoyed that open house.
I got to hear so much about life on campus from those current students.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But it seems too far for me to commute each day. If I'm going to attend that university, then I may want to live somewhere nearby.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
The sky's so cloudy...
And the ground's wet. It must've rained earlier.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I wish I could've seen the meteor shower...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We finished checking over those songs a lot quicker than I was initially expecting.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (To be fair, today's songs were the ones we regularly play during our shows.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I wonder what's going on with the Leonid meteor shower...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmm... I can't really see anything. It's too cloudy...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Also, there's no point in looking at it by myself...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I should get home and practice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Message
rows.Line: <I wrote a song to show my support for the three of you, and I had Miku sing it. I hope you get a chance to listen to it.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Yeah, she did say she was working on a Miku song.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A song to support us? What's it like?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's like she's saying, “I'm right here,” and, “Let's go together,” while holding my hand.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (She's reassuring me that even if things get tough, she'll be there for me. That I'm not alone.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (For some reason, while listening to this song...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My heart's starting to sink a bit.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki and Honami won't be joining us, so we can try doing this again another time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry, you two...!
Please forget what we just said.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think you should also prioritize your own dream, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Why am I getting the feeling that Ichika's incredibly lonely?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She hid how lonely she really was in order to write this song for us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's a bit unrefined, but it's also a great expression of who Ichika is...

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line:
<Can I call you, Ichi?
I wanna talk about your song.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Message
rows.Line: <I'm outside, but now should be fine since there's nobody else around.>

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line:
<Were you at work?
If we can talk in person, then I wanna do that!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Message
rows.Line: <No, I wasn't working. I was about to go to the park. I couldn't stay still after sending that song to all of you.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I just told you that I wanted to talk to you in person, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We felt the same way. After seeing your message, we knew that this is where you'd be.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks for writing that song for us, Ichi.
It made me really happy, and cheered me up so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
The same goes for me...
I actually started tearing up a little.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We understand exactly how you feel now.
Which is pretty amazing considering it was your very first song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I was totally focused on myself.
I never thought about how you were feeling, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That includes today. I told you that I had to go with my club instead of watching the meteor shower with you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Instead of flat out refusing your invitation, I could've offered to call you while looking up at the sky or join you later in the evening.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Saki...
But I didn't want you to...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've been wanting to hang out and spend more time together, but I didn't do anything to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I kept relying on the idea that you'd let me do what I want. That you'd all understand...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I also deserve some of the blame.
I should've done more, and I'm incredibly sorry...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me too. I'm so sorry, Ichika, Saki, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No...
You were all just doing your best to...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That isn't an excuse to leave a friend hanging.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Especially when they're feeling lonely.
Especially when that friend is forcing herself to be our cheerleader.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I also got that sense from your song, Ichika.
I understand your true feelings now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which means you must've spent quite a lot of effort channeling your feelings into this song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I did my best to keep those lonely thoughts out of it since I was trying to support all of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, you made your support crystal clear.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But... Even if you were able to cheer us up, you'd still be lonely.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Things would end with us being cheered up, and that doesn't feel right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I really want us to create another memory together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A precious memory that we can only create together right this moment.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let us know if there's anything you wanna do! We can do it together!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I was planning on singing the song I sent to all of you at the school festival...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Some girls are going to be performing as a band, so I was thinking about asking them to play for me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You're gonna be in a band, Ichi?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not exactly... More like collaborate with them. They'll play their instruments while I sing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Did you already ask them, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not yet. My plan was to ask them after I'd finished working on my song...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In that case, don't ask them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We should be the ones playing your song!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would you be okay with us performing it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've become much better at writing essays, so I'll ask them to reduce the number of assignments I need to do until the school festival.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I also promise to make time for practice!
I can stop practicing by myself during lunch, and keep my schedule open on weekends after club gets out!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I have to stay focused on my band's show since it's happening next week.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But things should settle down soon after, so I'll probably have time to practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, if we are gonna do this, we're not cutting any corners. Are you okay with that...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now, have you already applied to perform?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, but I've only told them that I'd be singing a song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The festival committee member in my class told me to have the details hammered out by next week.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, we gotta tell her that the four of us are gonna perform as a band♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, since we're going to be participating as a group, we'll need to come up with a name for ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. In our case, a band name.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know! What about “The Ichikas”?
She's the reason why we're doing this, and we'll be performing her song!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, that'd also be kind of embarrassing for me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I hope it's not another lame name.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're so mean, Shiho!
Anyway, it's not that...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But it was really cloudy just a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, over there! I just saw a shooting star!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too! Oh, there's another one!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so cool! They're everywhere!
Are you watching, Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, I'm watching. Try to relax.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We finally got to see it together again...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why don't we go with something that really suits us?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Then, a constellation...?
We are looking at the Leonid meteor shower right now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Look at Shiho on a sentimental streak♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There you go, poking fun at me again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's this meteor shower called in other languages...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
In English, this is the Leonid meteor shower.
And in French, they're called “Les Léonides”...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Léonides...?
That has a nice ring to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It even has the word “need” in it!
Like the way we all need each other♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Didn't we have this same conversation somewhere else before...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I was just thinking the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Spell out the name of our band!
One second...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right!
Then, Saki, you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Throw in a shooting star in the form of a slash!
Like this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've been doing all sorts of stuff as a band for like ever now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've done a ton of shows, and even produced our own songs!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's right. The four of us decided to go pro together in order to move the hearts of as many people as we could through our music...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we've been blessed enough to perform at some incredibly large venues!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The four of us get to keep being in a band together.
